sources.excerpt:
- **Archive parent:** SCM-20 Crossfire Metal
- **Builder:** CNZ Audio
- **Catalog type:** Distortion
- **Identity:** Compact analog metal distortion with Volume, Distortion, Tone and three-position Hi-Boost/Boost-Off/Lo-Boost switching. [1][2]

- **VOLUME**
- **DISTORTION**
- **TONE**
- **HI-BOOST / BOOST-OFF / LO-BOOST** toggle. [1][2]

- Analog high-gain distortion.
- The boost toggle shifts the emphasis around the core distortion rather than simply selecting a different pedal.
- The design is related in layout to CNZ's GDS-20 but substitutes Distortion for Gain and turns the toggle into an adjustable boost system. [1]

- Exact production transistor/device part number is not publicly documented.

- Exact clipping-device type and part number are not publicly documented.

- **9V DC, center-negative**.
- Approximately **10 mA** listed in the product specification, while one exact-model retail record also reports **25 mA working current**. The archive preserves the discrepancy rather than choosing one value without a reason. [1][2]
- **1 MOhm input impedance**
- **470 Ohm output impedance**.
- Solid-aluminum mini enclosure. [1][2]

- No numbered electronic revision established.

CNZ markets Crossfire Metal for hard rock and metal, emphasizing long sustain, dense saturation and a full tone. The three-position boost switch provides upper, neutral or lower-frequency emphasis. [1][2]

- **Identity:** High
- **Control map:** High
- **Metal orientation:** High
- **Boost switch:** High
- **9V:** High
- **Current draw:** Medium because two surviving references disagree
- **Exact transistor:** Unknown
- **Exact diode:** Unknown

The CNZ/Effects Database exact-model record and an exact Reverb listing were cross-checked. The sources agree on the control layout and boost functions, while preserving the documented 10mA versus 25mA current discrepancy. [1][2]

1. Effects Database — CNZ SCM-20 Crossfire Metal: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/cnz/crossfire
2. Reverb — CNZ SCM-20 Crossfire Metal: https://reverb.com/ca/item/55186251-cnz-audio-scm-20-crossfire-metal-distortion-pedal

- Exact-model image status remains handled separately.

CNZ Audio browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by enclosure pedal browse by enclosure mini pedal CNZ Audio SCM-20 Crossfire Metal Published on November 18, 2018 CNZ Audio distortion mini pedal pedal Information CNZ Audio Heavy? Nu? Black? Goth? Speed? Symphonic? Viking? Screamo? Unblack? Whatever your flavor of Metal... get caught in the Crossfire. Metal music has about as many sub-genres as cookies have crumbs. So, it makes sense that those genres and their players need versatile pedals. The CNZ Audio Crossfire Metal (SCM-20) is about as versatile as they come. Following a similar layout to our GDS-20, the SCM swaps the gain knob for a distortion adjustment and makes the toggle an adjustable boost. Those two items are key in giving you a wide range of distortion possibilities without overwhelming your board. Rock on, Metalheads.
